title:
Comment of Nok Ayala Xu in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/1/2026

documents.name: 152011.txt
documents.text:
Nok Ayala Xu, Keizer, OR.
Re: Docket No. P-15423-000 — DeepGreen Cook Inlet preliminary permit

My name is Nok Ayala Xu. I lived in Anchorage, and I moved out in 2002. I am planning to move back in 2030.

I am coming back for that shoreline — the wind off Cook Inlet and the water as I have envisioned it all these years. I want the shoreline I envisioned preserved.

This project would put hundreds of tidal turbines and underwater data-center pods in Cook Inlet, in the critical habitat of the Cook Inlet beluga whales. Those northern waters also hold the Bering Sea animals — the orca, the walrus, the bowhead, the humpback, the sperm whale, the North Pacific right whale, the narwhal, the ringed seal, the bearded seal, and the harbor porpoise. A permit to study it is still the first step down that road.

Please deny this permit. Keep the shoreline, and the belugas' home, as they are.

Nok Ayala Xu
Keizer, Oregon
